lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice a small set of common irregular preterite verbs.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A quick conversation about lunch and fika yesterday.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Reporting simple completed actions with common irregular verbs.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about where they went yesterday, when they came back, and what they ate or drank.

main_focus.name: common irregular preterite verbs
main_focus.description: Use a limited set of frequent irregular past-tense forms in everyday statements.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use common irregular preterite forms naturally 4-6 times, mainly gick, kom, åt, and drack.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use the irregular verbs in concrete lunch, coffee, and arrival contexts.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about lunch or fika yesterday.
dialogue_shape.middle: They mention going somewhere, arriving, eating, and drinking using the target verbs.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react briefly to the food, timing, or coffee.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the small irregular verb set without adding many new verbs

focus: whether someone came early or late

sentence_focus: one question about arriving on time
